blocks.text: CEBU CITY —Creamline continues to draw big crowds after 10 years in the Premier Volleyball League, as its opening game set an attendance record at SM Seaside Cebu Arena on Saturday with 19,106 fans. The record crowd watched Creamline kick off its title defense in the All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series with a 25-18, 25-21, 25-18 sweep of Akari. Jema Galanza led the Cool Smashers with 16 points. Creamline captain Alyssa Valdez, a 10-year league veteran, admitted the sight of thousands of fans overwhelmed the team. “In all honesty, I never thought we could fill an arena again.
